method: Brands found via WebSearch, newsletters, host calendars, MATO, local press; our data (events.json, sources.json, watchlist.json, review/*.md) checked only after selection. Instagram and Facebook pages not fetched.
caveats: data/events.json earliest start is 2026-10-24: pop-ups before that cannot be found by design, so found_by_our_data=no for them is not an adapter miss.
Sample is biased toward brands already visible to the same search engine, the Let It Simmer newsletter and MATO, which our pipeline also ingests.
